description:
A fantastic duo of a political master and a complete novice! I’m Gu Yeongjin, a six-term congressman — the pinnacle of South Korea’s political world, the nation’s hope! One fateful day in 2008, betrayed by my closest aides, I faced a special investigation and chose to end my own life. When I opened my eyes… it was Seoul, 10 years in the past?! Now a ghost, no one can see me or hear my voice. No one... except one person, Cha Jaerim, a 25-year-old Level 9 civil servant. No connections, no money, stuck in miserable circumstances... But look at that ambition, that fire in his eyes... I like it! Fine. I’ll make him my partner.

*“You need to go into politics.”*

And I’ll get my revenge. A political genius ghost, Gu Yeongjin, teams up with a clueless rookie, Cha Jaerim, for the ultimate combo in

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
